math4-place-value-number-sense.title: City Population Report
math4-place-value-number-sense.tagline: Be a data reporter: read, compare, order and round the populations of five cities.
math4-place-value-number-sense.description: Students become data reporters for a travel magazine. They read and write city populations in standard, word and expanded form, compare and order them, round them for headlines, and explain how the value of a digit changes from place to place.

math4-multi-digit-addition-subtraction.title: School Fundraiser Ledger
math4-multi-digit-addition-subtraction.tagline: Keep the books for the school fundraiser: add what comes in, subtract what goes out.
math4-multi-digit-addition-subtraction.description: Students act as treasurers for a school fundraiser. They add multi-digit sales totals, subtract costs, estimate to check that answers are reasonable, and solve multistep problems to find out whether the school reaches its goal.

math4-multiplication-strategies.title: Design a Theater
math4-multiplication-strategies.tagline: Design the seating for a new theater and use multiplication to count every seat.
math4-multiplication-strategies.description: Students design the seating plan for a community theater. They use arrays and area models to multiply, find partial products, compare amounts with multiplicative comparison, and calculate ticket sales for a sold-out show.

math4-division-remainders.title: Party Planner
math4-division-remainders.tagline: Plan a big party: divide guests, snacks and supplies, and decide what to do with what is left over.
math4-division-remainders.description: Students plan a school celebration. They divide to seat guests, share snacks and pack party bags, then decide what each remainder means: ignore it, add one more group, or use it as the answer. They check every quotient with multiplication.

math4-factors-multiples-patterns.title: Pattern Quilt
math4-factors-multiples-patterns.tagline: Design a quilt with factor pairs, multiples and repeating patterns.
math4-factors-multiples-patterns.description: Students design a class quilt. They use factor pairs to find every possible rectangular layout, decide which numbers of squares are prime or composite, use multiples to plan colors, and follow a pattern rule to predict what comes next.

math4-fractions-equivalent-fractions.title: Fraction Pizza Shop
math4-fractions-equivalent-fractions.tagline: Run a pizza shop where every order is a fraction to model, rename and compare.
math4-fractions-equivalent-fractions.description: Students run a pizza shop. They draw fraction models for orders, find equivalent fractions when pizzas are cut into more slices, compare fractions with different numerators and denominators, and put orders in order from least to greatest.

math4-fraction-operations-decimals.title: Recipe for a Crowd
math4-fraction-operations-decimals.tagline: Scale up a trail-mix recipe for the whole class with fraction and decimal math.
math4-fraction-operations-decimals.description: Students prepare trail mix for a class hike. They add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers with like denominators, multiply a fraction by a whole number to make several batches, and write tenths and hundredths as decimals to compare prices and weights.

math4-measurement-unit-conversions.title: Playground Blueprint
math4-measurement-unit-conversions.tagline: Draw the blueprint for a new playground using area, perimeter and unit conversions.
math4-measurement-unit-conversions.description: Students design a playground. They use the area and perimeter formulas for rectangles, find an unknown side length, convert larger units to smaller units, and solve problems about time, distance and money for the building project.

math4-geometry-angles-symmetry.title: Angle Art Studio
math4-geometry-angles-symmetry.tagline: Create a piece of geometric art, then measure and classify every line, angle and shape in it.
math4-geometry-angles-symmetry.description: Students create geometric artwork. They draw points, lines, rays and angles, measure and sketch angles with a protractor, add angle measures to find unknown angles, classify shapes by their sides and angles, and add lines of symmetry.

math4-data-line-plots-word-problems.title: Class Measurement Survey
math4-data-line-plots-word-problems.tagline: Collect measurements, display them on a line plot, and answer questions with the data.
math4-data-line-plots-word-problems.description: Students run a measurement survey. They read a data set of lengths measured to the nearest fraction of an inch, make a line plot, add and subtract fractions to answer questions about the data, and solve multistep problems.
